subject: general
question: Sunrise in the easternmost Arunachal Pradesh occurs how many hours before sunrise in the westernmost Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Two Hours.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **longitudinal extent between Gujarat and Arunachal Pradesh**, the two extreme western and eastern states of the country respectively, is about **30°**.
 
• It is due to this factor, that the time lag between the two states is **two hours__**.
 
• Earth rotates 360 degrees in 24 hours.
 
• So, it moves around **15 degrees in 1 hour**.
 
• Using this, we can say that it would move **__30 degrees in two hours__** which is the answer.
 
• Sun rises earlier in Arunachal Pradesh as compared to Gujarat.
 
• The Indian Standard Time is taken from the time of Standard Meridian of India.
 
• This is the reason why despite the time lag of sunrise and sunset, both show the same timings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• 1 degree of longitude is equal to 4 minutes.
 
• 15-degree longitude is 1 hour.
 
• One degree of latitude is 111 km on Earth's surface.
 
• When one crosses the International Date Line, the day and date changes.
 
• When one crosses IDL to the west, one loses the day.
 
• When one goes from west to east, one gains a day.
 
• Russia has the highest number of time zones.
 
• The prime meridian passes through Greenwich in England which is zero degrees longitude.
 
• Opposite of prime meridian is IDL which is at 180-degree longitude.
 
• IDL is a zigzag line and passes through Bering Strait.
